title: 第42章 一路之上第43章 悟性悟法
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
又过了七八天时间，赵宇终于走到浮云山脉的外围，本来他还想在外围找一些有用的东西，可那些东西对现在的赵宇来说，一无可用，赵宇也懒得收取。
就在下山途中碰到几个猎户在围杀一头健硕的野牛，那头野牛顶伤一位猎人，冲出几位猎人的包围圈，刚好冲向赵宇，这头野牛健壮凶猛，此刻又狂性大发，朝赵宇直撞过来。
不过它终究还是一头凡兽，赵宇轻轻地拍出一掌，那头野牛飞出七八丈之远，呜呼哀哉。
赵宇微微一笑，对自己现在所掌控的力量还是有些满意的。
那几个跟着野牛追过的猎人，看到这梦幻的一幕，立刻停止脚步，身体都有些发抖，看着赵宇一脸紧张，生怕赵宇顺手把他们一起拍了。
过了片刻，一位年纪稍长的猎人走了上来，朝赵宇躬身一礼，开口道：“这位公子，刚才我等惊扰了公子，万分见谅，恳请公子宽宥。”
听见这一番言语，赵宇心想看来这位猎手也是有些见识的。
这下反而把赵宇搞得有些不好意思，小脸还有些发烫，这十多年来他和人类打交道本就不多。
他随即摆摆手道：“没什么，没什么，谈不上惊扰，小事而已。”
随后就想离开。
“等等！”
那位猎人见赵宇要离开，忙叫住了赵宇，指了指那头野牛，“这是公子的猎物，公子请收起。”
赵宇笑了笑道：“这东西我不需要，你们收着吧。”
这几位猎人心中一阵狂喜，本来他们追这个野牛好长一会了，只是这头野牛太过强壮，他们一直没有拿下，而且有两人还受了一些伤，其中刚才被那野牛顶伤的那个猎人，伤得还不轻。
在他们那里，这个三千来斤的野牛可价值不菲。
他们想收走，又怕赵宇生气，所以先推辞一下，看看赵宇的态度。
赵宇倒没有去体会他们的心思，这种猎物他现在确实是看不上的。
赵宇又看了看那位躺在地上受伤不轻的猎人，拿出一颗丹药，这是刚开始学炼丹时炼制的，品级最低，质量也最差，倒不是赵宇小气，而是那些品级高的丹药对这些个凡胎俗体的猎人是承受不起的。
他把丹药递给了那位应该是领头的猎人，说道：“那人受伤不轻，你把这药给他服下吧。”
那猎人顿时吃了一惊，那少年公子不但送他猎物，还给他们疗伤的药物，简直在梦中一样，一般像这样的少年公子从来都不会正眼看他们一下。

他诚惶诚恐地拿过药丸，走过去给那受伤的猎人服了下去。
他也一点都担心赵宇会害他们，因为只要赵宇想灭他们，还不是一巴掌的事！
赵宇依旧站着没有马上离开，一是他想看看自己炼制的药物效果如何，二是刚好碰到这些猎人，问一下出山的路，那几个猎人一定是住在附近的猎户，对这里一定很熟悉。
也就十多个呼吸，那个被野牛顶伤的猎人本来一直“哼哼”
叫唤，可能伤到筋骨和内脏了。
服下药也就一会突然感到伤势大好，基本上感觉不到痛了，且能站起来了。
他内心很是激动，那他刚才受的伤若是平常，就是喝汤吃药，在床上起码要躺个十天半月的，而现在只是片刻，就基本痊愈，实是不敢想象，一定是什么神药！
他激动之余，走上几步，就想对赵宇拜服下去，以示感谢！
赵宇忙用手轻轻一摔，一道气劲阻止要向下拜倒的猎人：“不必如何，小事而已，你的伤还没全好，不宜多动。”
赵宇又转头看向那个领头的猎人，问道：“这位大哥，从这里出山，路还远吗？方便的话请告诉我一下。”
“方便，方便！”
那位领头的猎人嘴唇一阵哆嗦，顿感受宠若惊，这位似神仙一样的少年公子还称他大哥，他如何不惊！
赵宇看着他们的样子内心一阵感叹，这个世界真是强者为尊，弱者为蚁啊！
那位领头的猎人赶忙从旁边捡了一根树枝，他怕说不清，所以拿着树枝边说边给赵宇在地上画图，仔细地告诉赵宇出山的路线。
他说完画完，又对赵宇躬身一礼，说道：“公子若是有时间，不妨到我们村上休息几日，我们很欢迎公子光临！”
赵宇摇了摇头：“不了，我还有事，就不打扰你们了，谢谢你的指路！”
说完，也对他还施一礼，朝那刚才猎人所指之路飞腾而去。
他现在的龙腾身法益加纯熟，随着他境界的提升，修为的提高，龙腾步更似龙翔九天，雷霆迅猛，一眨眼间，赵宇就失去了踪影。
那几个腊人挣着嘴巴，真正的目瞪口呆，其中一个猎人对那领头猎人问道：“姜大哥，我们这次是不是真的碰到神仙了？”
那位领头的姜姓猎人想了一会晃了晃头说道：“神仙应该不是，但必是高人！”

随后对几人说道；“这次出来打猎太幸运了，其他的别管了，把那大家伙弄回去。”
众人听完，皆兴奋地一声吼叫，奔向那庞大的野牛。

content_en:
After another seven or eight days, Zhao Yu finally reached the outskirts of Fuyun Mountain Range. Originally, he wanted to find some useful things on the outskirts, but those things were useless to Zhao Yu now, and Zhao Yu was too lazy to collect them.
On the way down the mountain, I encountered several hunters surrounding and killing a strong bison. The bison gored a hunter and broke out of the circle of hunters. It happened to rush towards Zhao Yu. This bison was strong and ferocious. At this moment, it became mad again and rushed towards Zhao Yu.
But it was still an ordinary beast after all. Zhao Yu gently slapped his palm, and the bison flew seven or eight feet away, lamenting.
Zhao Yu smiled slightly, still somewhat satisfied with the power he now controlled.
The hunters who had followed the bison stopped immediately when they saw this dreamy scene, their bodies trembling a little. They looked at Zhao Yu with a nervous look on his face, for fear that Zhao Yu would take a picture of them all.
After a while, an older hunter came up, bowed to Zhao Yu, and said: "Master, I have disturbed you just now. I am extremely sorry for this, and I beg you to forgive me."
Hearing these words, Zhao Yu thought to himself that this hunter also had some knowledge.
This made Zhao Yu feel a little embarrassed, and his face was a little hot. He had not interacted with humans much in the past ten years.
He immediately waved his hand and said: "It's nothing, nothing. It's not disturbing, it's just a trivial matter."
Then I wanted to leave.
"Wait!"
When the hunter saw that Zhao Yu was about to leave, he quickly stopped Zhao Yu and pointed at the bison, "This is the young master's prey. Please put it away, young master."
Zhao Yu smiled and said: "I don't need this thing, you can keep it."
These hunters felt ecstatic in their hearts. They had been chasing the bison for a long time, but the bison was too strong and they never captured it. Moreover, two of them suffered some injuries. Among them, the hunter who was gored by the bison just now was seriously injured.
To them, this 3,000-pound bison is worth a lot of money.
They wanted to take it away, but were afraid that Zhao Yu would be angry, so they declined first to see Zhao Yu's attitude.
Zhao Yu didn't understand their thoughts. He really didn't like this kind of prey now.
Zhao Yu looked at the badly injured hunter lying on the ground and took out an elixir. This was made when he first learned alchemy. It was of the lowest grade and the worst quality. It was not that Zhao Yu was stingy, but that those high-grade elixirs could not be afforded by these mortal hunters.
He handed the elixir to the hunter who should be the leader and said, "That man is seriously injured. Give him this medicine."
The hunter was immediately shocked. The young master not only gave him prey, but also gave them healing medicine. It was like in a dream. Generally, young masters like this would never look at them.
He took the pills with fear, walked over and gave it to the injured hunter.
He was not worried at all that Zhao Yu would harm them, because as long as Zhao Yu wanted to destroy them, it was not a matter of a slap!
Zhao Yu still stood and did not leave immediately. Firstly, he wanted to see the effect of the medicine he refined. Secondly, he happened to meet these hunters and asked for the way out of the mountain. Those hunters must be hunters living nearby and must be familiar with this place.
In just over ten breaths, the hunter who was gored by the bison kept "humming"
Yelling may injure the muscles, bones and internal organs.
After taking the medicine, I suddenly felt that the injury was greatly improved. I basically felt no pain and could stand up.
He was very excited in his heart. If the injury he suffered just now was normal, he would have to lie in bed for at least ten and a half days just by drinking soup and taking medicine. But now it only takes a moment and he is basically healed. I can't imagine that it must be some kind of miracle medicine!
He was so excited that he took a few steps and wanted to bow down to Zhao Yu to express his gratitude!
Zhao Yu hurriedly threw it lightly with his hand, and a force of energy stopped him.The hunter who was about to prostrate himself said: "It doesn't matter, it's just a trivial matter. Your injuries are not fully healed yet, so you shouldn't move too much."
Zhao Yu turned to look at the leading hunter again and asked, "Brother, is there still a long way to get out of the mountain from here? Please tell me if it's convenient."
“Convenient, convenient!”
The leading hunter's lips trembled for a while, and he felt flattered. This young master who looked like a god also called him big brother. How could he not be surprised!
Zhao Yu looked at them and sighed in his heart, this world is really where the strong are respected and the weak are like ants!
The leading hunter hurriedly picked up a branch from the side. He was afraid that he could not explain clearly, so he took the branch and drew a picture on the ground for Zhao Yu, carefully telling Zhao Yu the route out of the mountain.
After he finished speaking and painting, he bowed to Zhao Yu and said, "If you have time, you might as well come to our village to rest for a few days. We welcome you!"
Zhao Yu shook his head: "No, I still have something to do, so I won't disturb you anymore. Thank you for your guidance!"
After saying that, he also bowed to him and flew towards the path pointed by the hunter just now.
He is now becoming more and more proficient in the Dragon Soaring Body Technique. As his realm and cultivation improve, the Dragon Soaring Steps become more like a dragon flying through the sky. The thunder is so fast that in the blink of an eye, Zhao Yu disappears.
The wax men opened their mouths and were truly dumbfounded. One of the hunters asked the leading hunter: "Brother Jiang, have we really met the gods this time?"
The leading hunter surnamed Jiang thought for a while, shook his head and said, "I'm probably not a god, but he must be an expert!"
Then he said to several people, "I'm so lucky to go hunting this time. Don't worry about anything else and get that big guy back."
After everyone heard this, they all roared excitedly and ran towards the huge bison.
